what: ON-Harmony (ds004712 v2.0.1): one Siemens Prisma scan's ensemble envelope against the same person's scan on a second Prisma at another Oxford site (same model and protocol), as stated and with recalibration maps; beside same-scanner rescans
registration: multi-start: (a) mode 1's pipeline on the mean b0s, (b) mode 2's FA stage, (c) the other direction's transform inverted, where it exists; each refined by rigid MI on the corrected mean b0s, the best final b0 NCC kept (bench/_register_fa.py, mode 3)
coverage: calibration_card.coverage_curve: the share of the rescan's density presence inside the envelope, the 42 named tracts pooled, weighted by the rescan's voxels; a subject's mean over its rescans of a term

PRISMA_UKB_OXF1.series: dir-AP: 5 b0s (b = 5), 50 b1000, 50 b2000 interleaved; the b0s and b2000 kept (55 volumes)
PRISMA_UKB_OXF1.reversed series: dir-PA in the same session: its b0s only (3; phase B's 3 b2000 volumes are not used)
PRISMA_UKB_OXF1.note: UK Biobank-style protocol on OXF1PRI (Head_32), b2000 x50 alone, tracked at 2000

PRISMA_UKB_OXF2.series: dir-AP: 5 b0s (b = 5), 50 b1000, 50 b2000 interleaved; the b0s and b2000 kept (55 volumes)
PRISMA_UKB_OXF2.reversed series: dir-PA in the same session: its b0s only (3; phase B's 3 b2000 volumes are not used)
PRISMA_UKB_OXF2.note: UK Biobank-style protocol on OXF2PRI (HeadNeck_64), b2000 x50 alone, tracked at 2000

provenance.downloads: bench/fetch_ds004712.py, every size equal to OpenNeuro's S3 listing (ds004712/fetched.json)

caveats: 20 cross-site pairs, one each (the forward direction); 4 same-scanner subjects, 5 rescans each (2 per Prisma): the same-scanner map is fitted on 3 (or 1) subjects once the target person is left out

the two Prismas differ in coil (32 against 64 channels), site, shim and gradient hardware (serial numbers), not in software or protocol; time is confounded the other way: the cross-site rescan is mostly the same day (scan_delays.csv: 0 days for 16 of 20 subjects, at most 5), the same-scanner rescans 0-205 days after A (13192 32-38, 16974 30-37, 14229 119-205, 16766 0-5); see "days between A and the rescan"
multiband 3: the bootstrap's smooth signs keep in-plane noise correlation, not the correlation between slices excited together
the voxel is 2.0192 x 2.0192 x 2.0 mm: a denser grid than cohort II's 2.5 mm, so about twice the seeds and streamlines per run (every mask voxel is a seed) and a point lattice of about 8 mm
the PA b0s (3) and the 5 forward b0s give the field; the readout time is stated (0.069 s) on both scanners
